question: What is the total sales revenue?
sql: SELECT SUM(sales) FROM shop_sales;

question: Show top 5 best selling products by revenue
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, SUM(se.units_sold * p.retail_price) AS total_revenue FROM products p JOIN sales_events se ON p.sku = se.sku GROUP BY p.style_name, p.sku ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the total sales by payment method?
sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(sales) FROM shop_sales GROUP BY payment_method;

question: Which city has the highest sales revenue?
sql: SELECT s.city, SUM(s.sales) FROM shop_sales s GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY SUM(s.sales) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show sales breakdown by shop name
sql: SELECT shop_name, SUM(sales) AS total_sales FROM shop_sales GROUP BY shop_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What is the total quantity of units sold across all shops?
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM shop_sales;

question: List all transactions paid via Credit Card
sql: SELECT transaction_id, date, product, shop_name, city, quantity, sales, profit, payment_method FROM shop_sales WHERE LOWER(payment_method) = 'credit card';

question: Show sales in Bengaluru
sql: SELECT s.transaction_id, s.date, s.product, s.shop_name, s.city, s.quantity, s.sales, s.profit, s.payment_method FROM shop_sales s WHERE LOWER(s.city) = 'bengaluru';

question: What is the average transaction sales amount?
sql: SELECT AVG(sales) FROM shop_sales;

question: Show top selling products by quantity sold
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, SUM(se.units_sold) AS total_sold FROM products p JOIN sales_events se ON p.sku = se.sku GROUP BY p.style_name, p.sku ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which product generated the highest total profit?
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, p.retail_price, p.unit_cost, SUM(ss.profit) AS total_profit FROM products p JOIN shop_sales ss ON LOWER(p.style_name) = LOWER(ss.product) GROUP BY p.sku ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show total profit by city
sql: SELECT SUM(ss.profit) AS total_profit, ss.city FROM shop_sales ss GROUP BY ss.city ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

question: What is the overall profit across all sales?
sql: SELECT SUM(s.profit) FROM shop_sales s;

question: Show profit by shop name sorted from highest to lowest
sql: SELECT shop_name, SUM(profit) FROM shop_sales GROUP BY shop_name ORDER BY SUM(profit) DESC;
defects: Asked for LOWEST, but SQL has DESC

question: Which category has the highest profit margin?
sql: SELECT p.category, (p.retail_price - p.unit_cost) / p.retail_price FROM products p JOIN shop_sales s ON LOWER(p.style_name) = LOWER(s.product) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY (p.retail_price - p.unit_cost) / p.retail_price DESC;

question: Show products with unit cost greater than 30
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, p.category, p.unit_cost FROM products p WHERE p.unit_cost > 30;

question: What is the average profit per transaction?
sql: SELECT AVG(profit) FROM shop_sales;

question: Which products have the lowest profit margin?
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, p.retail_price, p.unit_cost, p.category FROM products p JOIN shop_sales s ON LOWER(p.style_name) = LOWER(s.product) ORDER BY (p.retail_price - p.unit_cost) ASC LIMIT 10;

question: Show total sales and total profit by category
sql: SELECT SUM(sales) AS total_sales, SUM(profit) AS total_profit, p.category FROM shop_sales s JOIN products p ON LOWER(p.style_name) = LOWER(s.product) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

question: What is the total cost across all sales transactions?
sql: SELECT SUM(unit_price * quantity) FROM shop_sales;

question: Which products are currently out of stock?
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= 0;

question: Show products where stock count is less than or equal to reorder point
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point;

question: What is the total stock count across all products in inventory?
sql: SELECT SUM(i.stock_count) FROM inventory i;

question: Show inventory levels for all products sorted by stock count ascending
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku ORDER BY i.stock_count ASC;

question: Which product has the highest stock count?
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku ORDER BY i.stock_count DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show all inventory items located in Main Warehouse
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE LOWER(i.location) = 'main warehouse';

question: List products that have stock count greater than 40
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count > 40;

question: Show products with stock count between 10 and 25
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count BETWEEN 10 AND 25;

question: What is the average stock count per SKU?
sql: SELECT AVG(i.stock_count) FROM inventory i;

question: Show inventory items that were never restocked or have null restock date
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count = 0 OR i.last_restocked_at IS NULL;

question: Show high risk products with stockout risk
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point;

question: Show dead stock products that have had no recent sales
sql: SELECT p.sku, p.style_name, i.stock_count FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count > 0 AND p.sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM sales_events WHERE sale_date >= date('now', '-90 days'));

question: Which products have critical stock below 5 units?
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= 5;

question: Show products where current stock is zero but reorder point is greater than 5
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count = 0 AND i.reorder_point > 5;

question: Which products have more stock than double their reorder point?
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count > 2 * i.reorder_point;

question: List SKUs where stock count is exactly equal to reorder point
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count = i.reorder_point;

question: Show products at stockout risk sorted by reorder point descending
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.location, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point ORDER BY i.reorder_point DESC;

question: What percentage of inventory items are below their reorder point?
sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(i.sku) FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku;

question: Show out of stock products with their style name and category
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.category FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE LOWER(i.stock_count) <= 0 ORDER BY p.style_name DESC;

question: Which categories have the most products at stockout risk?
sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count <= i.reorder_point GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which suppliers have an on time delivery rate below 85%?
sql: SELECT supplier_name, on_time_rate FROM suppliers WHERE on_time_rate < 0.85;

question: List all suppliers and their lead times sorted by lead time days
sql: SELECT supplier_name, lead_time_days FROM suppliers ORDER BY lead_time_days DESC;

question: What is the average supplier lead time in days?
sql: SELECT AVG(lead_time_days) FROM suppliers;

question: Which supplier has the highest on time rate?
sql: SELECT supplier_name, on_time_rate FROM suppliers ORDER BY on_time_rate DESC LIMIT 1;

question: How many total suppliers are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(supplier_id) FROM suppliers;

question: List all suppliers and their countries
sql: SELECT supplier_name, country FROM suppliers;

question: Which supplier has the longest lead time?
sql: SELECT supplier_name, lead_time_days FROM suppliers ORDER BY lead_time_days DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show suppliers with lead time less than or equal to 7 days
sql: SELECT supplier_name, lead_time_days, on_time_rate, country FROM suppliers WHERE LOWER(lead_time_days) <= 7;

question: Show suppliers who deliver with on time rate of 95% or better
sql: SELECT supplier_name, on_time_rate FROM suppliers WHERE on_time_rate >= 0.95;

question: List supplier names in alphabetical order
sql: SELECT supplier_name FROM suppliers ORDER BY supplier_name ASC;

question: Show all purchase orders with status Draft
sql: SELECT po_number, product_name, quantity, supplier_name, status, total_amount FROM purchase_orders WHERE LOWER(status) = 'draft';

question: What is the total quantity ordered in purchase orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM purchase_orders;

question: List all purchase orders for Sneakers
sql: SELECT po_number, product_name, quantity, supplier_name, status, total_amount FROM purchase_orders WHERE LOWER(product_name) = 'sneakers';

question: Show recent purchase orders sorted by id descending
sql: SELECT po_number, product_name, quantity, supplier_name, status, total_amount FROM purchase_orders ORDER BY id DESC;

question: Show purchase orders grouped by status with count
sql: SELECT po.status, COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders po GROUP BY po.status;

question: What is the total amount value of all purchase orders?
sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM purchase_orders;

question: Which purchase order has the largest total amount?
sql: SELECT po_number, total_amount FROM purchase_orders ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List purchase orders for Shoe Point supplier
sql: SELECT po_number, product_name, quantity, supplier_name, status, total_amount FROM purchase_orders WHERE supplier_name = 'Shoe Point';

question: Show purchase orders with quantity greater than 10
sql: SELECT po_number, product_name, quantity, supplier_name, status, total_amount FROM purchase_orders WHERE quantity > 10;

question: How many purchase orders have been created so far?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM purchase_orders;

question: How many total products exist in the catalog?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products;

question: What is the average retail price of products?
sql: SELECT AVG(p.retail_price) FROM products p;

question: Show the 5 most expensive products by retail price
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, p.category, p.retail_price FROM products p ORDER BY p.retail_price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List all products in the Footwear category
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, p.category, p.retail_price FROM products p WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'footwear';

question: Show all products with retail price greater than 50
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, p.category, p.retail_price FROM products p WHERE retail_price > 50;

question: List distinct product categories
sql: SELECT DISTINCT LOWER(p.category) FROM products p;

question: Show all products available in size M
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, p.category, p.retail_price, p.size FROM products p WHERE LOWER(p.size) = 'm';

question: Which products have unit cost less than 20?
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, p.category, p.unit_cost FROM products p WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'footwear' AND p.unit_cost < 20;

question: Show products and their profit margin (retail price minus unit cost)
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, p.retail_price, p.unit_cost, (p.retail_price - p.unit_cost) AS profit_margin FROM products p;

question: List products in the Electronics category sorted by price
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, p.retail_price FROM products p WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'electronics' ORDER BY p.retail_price DESC;

question: Show product style name, stock count, and supplier name
sql: SELECT p.style_name, i.stock_count, s.supplier_name FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id ORDER BY i.stock_count DESC;

question: Which supplier provides the products with the lowest stock?
sql: SELECT s.supplier_name, p.sku, i.stock_count FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id ORDER BY i.stock_count ASC;

question: Show style name and reorder point for all products
sql: SELECT p.style_name, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku ORDER BY p.style_name ASC;

question: List products with their current stock and retail price
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, p.retail_price FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku ORDER BY p.retail_price DESC;

question: Show supplier name for Oxford Shirt
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, s.supplier_name FROM products p JOIN suppliers s ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id WHERE LOWER(p.style_name) = 'oxford shirt' ORDER BY p.retail_price DESC;

question: Show total sales volume for products supplied by Shoe Point
sql: SELECT SUM(sales) FROM shop_sales WHERE product IN (SELECT style_name FROM products WHERE supplier_id IN (SELECT supplier_id FROM suppliers WHERE supplier_name = 'Shoe Point'));

question: Which product category has the most units in stock?
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(i.stock_count) FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(i.stock_count) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show products that have pending purchase orders and their stock level
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, po.po_number, po.status FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku JOIN purchase_orders po ON p.sku = po.product_id WHERE po.status = 'pending';

question: List products with style name, category, and total units sold in sales_events
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.category, SUM(se.units_sold) FROM products p JOIN sales_events se ON p.sku = se.sku GROUP BY p.sku, p.style_name, p.category ORDER BY SUM(se.units_sold) DESC;

question: Which supplier supplies the most expensive product?
sql: SELECT p.supplier_id, p.retail_price FROM products p ORDER BY p.retail_price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List all warehouses and their cities
sql: SELECT warehouse_id, name, city, country, capacity_units FROM warehouses;

question: What is the total capacity across all warehouses?
sql: SELECT SUM(capacity_units) FROM warehouses;

question: Which warehouse has the highest capacity?
sql: SELECT warehouse_id, name, city, country, capacity_units FROM warehouses ORDER BY capacity_units DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Show warehouse details for Mumbai
sql: SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.name, w.city, w.country, w.capacity_units FROM warehouses w WHERE LOWER(w.city) = 'mumbai';

question: List warehouses sorted by capacity ascending
sql: SELECT warehouse_id, name, city, country, capacity_units FROM warehouses ORDER BY capacity_units ASC;

question: How many active warehouses do we operate?
sql: SELECT COUNT(warehouse_id) FROM warehouses;

question: What is the average warehouse capacity?
sql: SELECT AVG(capacity_units) FROM warehouses;

question: Show warehouse name and city for warehouses in India
sql: SELECT name, city FROM warehouses WHERE LOWER(country) = 'india';

question: Which warehouse has capacity greater than 40000 units?
sql: SELECT warehouse_id, name, city, country, capacity_units FROM warehouses WHERE capacity_units > 40000;

question: List warehouses and their latitude and longitude coordinates
sql: SELECT warehouse_id, name, city, country, capacity_units FROM warehouses;

question: Show sales in Mysuru paid with Online / UPI
sql: SELECT transaction_id, date, product, shop_name, city, quantity, sales, profit, payment_method FROM shop_sales WHERE LOWER(city) = 'mysuru' AND LOWER(payment_method) = 'online/u pi';

question: What is the total profit for Clothing category?
sql: SELECT SUM(s.profit) FROM shop_sales s JOIN products p ON LOWER(p.style_name) = LOWER(s.product) WHERE LOWER(p.category) = 'clothing';

question: Count how many transactions were made in each city
sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM shop_sales GROUP BY city;

question: Show average units sold per sales event
sql: SELECT AVG(units_sold) FROM sales_events;

question: Find products that have zero stock but reorder point greater than 10
sql: SELECT p.style_name, p.sku, i.stock_count, i.reorder_point FROM products p JOIN inventory i ON p.sku = i.sku WHERE i.stock_count = 0 AND i.reorder_point > 10;

question: Show total sales and total profit by shop name in Bengaluru
sql: SELECT shop_name, SUM(sales) AS total_sales, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM shop_sales WHERE LOWER(city) = 'bengaluru' GROUP BY shop_name ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

question: List top 3 cities with the lowest total sales
sql: SELECT s.city, SUM(s.sales) FROM shop_sales s GROUP BY s.city ORDER BY SUM(s.sales) ASC LIMIT 3;

question: Show sales transactions where customer type is VIP
sql: SELECT transaction_id, date, product, shop_name, city, quantity, sales, profit, payment_method FROM shop_sales WHERE LOWER(customer_type) = 'vip';

question: What is the highest single transaction sales amount?
sql: SELECT MAX(sales) FROM shop_sales;

question: Show total sales grouped by category and sorted by sales descending
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(ss.sales) FROM products p JOIN shop_sales ss ON LOWER(p.style_name) = LOWER(ss.product) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(ss.sales) DESC;
